Elements matching CSS attribute selector are excluded entirely

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"exclude_selectors\":[\"[role='complementary']\"]}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<body><div role=\"complementary\">Sidebar</div><p>Primary text</p></body>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
